proposals.evidence: CDIAL 5679 tapta explicitly gives Hindi tāta/tātā and Kashmiri totu hot. These t-bearing adjectives fit the unextended hot family, with Kullui vowel colouring retained. Exact source form t̪ot̪ə is preserved.
